mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when GDP is increasing, or if the correlation between GDP growth and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts combined with a decrease in retail sales signals a shift in consumer spending from goods to housing, which may indicate a weakening in consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and RSAFS decreases > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the joint behavior of HOUST and RSAFS does not show a statistically significant correlation with negative returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production over two consecutive months signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when INDPRO is declining, or if the correlation between INDPRO decline and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 100k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the joint behavior of PAYEMS and UNRATE does not show a statistically significant correlation with positive returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index over two consecutive months signals inflationary pressures, which can lead to monetary tightening and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when CPIAUCSL is increasing, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in retail sales combined with an increase in the federal funds rate signals a contraction in consumer spending and tightening monetary policy, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases > 2% and FEDFUNDS increases > 0.25% in 1 month
regime_hint: consumer spending contraction and monetary tightening
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met, or if the joint behavior of RSAFS and FEDFUNDS does not show a statistically significant correlation with negative returns (p > 0.05).
